name: Retro print
oneLiner: a risograph poster that boils: cream paper, a two-red sunburst turning on twos, thick-outlined props and an old computer with a pixel screen, an extruded title, every edge crawling like ink
bestFor: newsletters, weekly series, content drops, creator brands, square social posts and loops; anything that should feel handmade, warm and collectible
motion: on twos: a cursor click, the hero shrinks into the rays, the panel drops and the title slams, props burst out, a jittering hold with a ticking stopwatch, then a collapse and loop; the displacement seed changes every 1/12 s

sound.ui: click on the cursor, pop on the sparkle, whoosh on the shrink and the collapse, one hit on the drop and title slam, ticks with the stopwatch
